{{Quote|By the end of the Republic the Coruscanti Prajii were born fops and career bureaucrats, but some entered military service. One such was Colonel Collin Praji&hellip;|Dr. Gabrel Treon in ''Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes|<ref name="tinker" />}}
'''Collin Praji''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] [[House Praji/Legends|House Praji]] who lived before the [[Declaration of a New Order|end]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Praji [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and enrolled for military service, unlike many members of the Praji family, who took to lives as dandies and [[Bureaucrat/Legends|functionaries]]. Eventually, Praji attained the rank of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]]. The Kalandar Installation, located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], was rechristened [[Fort Praji]] in Praji's honor. In [[104 ABY]], the [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Academician|Dr.]] [[Gabrel Treon]] mentioned Praji in an article Treon wrote about the [[House Praji/Legends|House Praji]] family, "[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes]]."<ref name="tinker" />

==Behind the scenes==
Collin Praji was mentioned in ''[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]'', a [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive [[in-universe]] history article written by [[Nathan O'Keefe]] and published on [[February 5]], [[2009]].<ref name="tinker" />
